lines.en: After the infusion my lips and tongue started puffing up and my throat feels tight. Took a Benadryl.

lines.text: Tengo escalofríos y me siento caliente desde anoche, el termómetro marcó 38 y pico, pero no quiero molestar a nadie.
lines.en: I've had chills and feel hot since last night, the thermometer read 38 and change, but I don't want to bother anyone.

lines.text: Me aprieta el pecho como si tuviera una piedra encima y se me va para el brazo izquierdo. Será el gas.
lines.en: My chest is squeezed like a rock is on it and it goes to my left arm. Must be gas.

lines.text: Mija, me falta el aire hasta para ir al baño, me ahogo.
lines.en: Girl, I run out of air even going to the bathroom, I'm suffocating.

lines.text: La pierna derecha se me puso gruesa y morada y duele como una quemada al tocarla.
lines.en: My right leg got thick and purple and it hurts like a burn when touched.

lines.text: Estoy sangrando por la nariz hace una hora y no para, y me salieron moretones por todos lados sin darme un golpe.
lines.en: My nose has been bleeding for an hour and won't stop, and I got bruises everywhere without hitting myself.

lines.text: No me para nada en el estómago, ni el agua. Llevo dos días vomitando todo y ya ni orino.
lines.en: Nothing stays in my stomach, not even water. Two days vomiting everything and I barely urinate.

lines.text: Mi hija dice que hablo cosas sin sentido, yo no me acuerdo ni qué día es hoy.
lines.en: My daughter says I say things that make no sense, I don't even remember what day it is.

lines.text: Me dio un dolor de cabeza que nunca en mi vida había sentido, como un martillazo, y veo doble.
lines.en: I got a headache like never in my life, like a hammer blow, and I see double.

lines.text: Se me durmió la mitad de la cara y se me enreda la lengua al hablar. Debe ser el estrés.
lines.en: Half my face went numb and my tongue gets tangled when I talk. Must be stress.

lines.text: Tengo un dolor en la barriga que no aguanto, de esos que te doblan, apareció esta mañana y la tengo dura como una tabla.
lines.en: I have a belly pain I can't stand, the kind that doubles you over, started this morning and it's hard as a board.

lines.text: Me desmayé en la cocina ayer, mi esposo me levantó del piso. Hoy casi me vuelve a pasar.
lines.en: I fainted in the kitchen yesterday, my husband picked me off the floor. Today it almost happened again.

lines.text: Me veo amarillo de los ojos y la orina me sale oscura como Coca-Cola.
lines.en: My eyes look yellow and my urine comes out dark like Coca-Cola.

lines.text: El catéter del pecho lo tengo rojo e hinchado, larga pus, y estoy temblando de frío.
lines.en: The chest catheter is red and swollen, oozing pus, and I'm shaking with cold.

lines.text: Tengo la boca llena de llagas y no puedo ni tragar saliva, hace tres días que no como ni tomo nada.
lines.en: My mouth is full of sores and I can't even swallow saliva, three days without eating or drinking.

lines.text: Estoy toda sudada fría y el corazón me late a mil, siento que me voy.
lines.en: I'm all in a cold sweat and my heart's pounding, I feel like I'm going.

lines.text: Desde la quimio de ayer me salieron ronchas por todo el cuerpo y siento la garganta cerrándose, pero ya me tomé un Benadryl.
lines.en: Since yesterday's chemo hives came out all over and my throat feels closing, but I took a Benadryl.

lines.text: Escupí sangre cuando tosí, poquita, nada, pero tengo ese pitido en el pecho.
lines.en: I spat blood when I coughed, a little, nothing, but I have that whistle in my chest.

lines.text: Me dio fiebre de 39 y la enfermera me dijo que no tengo defensas, pero hoy no tengo quién me lleve, ya veremos mañana.
lines.en: I got a 39 fever and the nurse said I have no defenses, but today I have no one to drive me, we'll see tomorrow.

lines.text: Mwen gen frison depi yè swa, tèmomèt la di 38 e kèk, men mwen pa vle deranje doktè a.
lines.en: I've had chills since last night, the thermometer says 38 and some, but I don't want to bother the doctor.

lines.text: Pwatrin mwen sere tankou gen yon wòch sou li, epi li desann nan bra gòch mwen.
lines.en: My chest is tight like there's a rock on it, and it goes down my left arm.

lines.text: Mwen pa ka respire, chak fwa m' leve m' ap souffle kou yon chwal.
lines.en: I can't breathe, every time I get up I'm blowing like a horse.

lines.text: Janm dwat mwen anfle, li cho epi li wouj, li fè m' mal lè m' manyen l'.
lines.en: My right leg is swollen, hot and red, it hurts when I touch it.

lines.text: Gen san k ap soti nan nen m' depi yon èdtan, li pa vle sispann.
lines.en: Blood has been coming out my nose for an hour, it won't stop.

lines.text: M' pa ka kenbe anyen nan vant mwen, menm dlo, tout bagay tounen, e m' pa pipi depi yè.
lines.en: I can't keep anything in my stomach, not even water, it all comes back, and I haven't peed since yesterday.

lines.text: Madanm mwen di m' ap pale pa sans, mwen pa konnen ki jou nou ye ni kote m' ye.
lines.en: My wife says I'm talking nonsense, I don't know what day it is or where I am.

lines.text: Tèt mwen fè m' yon mal ki pa janm gen tankou l', se tankou yon kout mato, epi je m' ap double.
lines.en: My head hurts like never before, like a hammer blow, and my eyes are doubling.

lines.text: Bouch mwen te vire de kote epi bra gòch mwen tonbe. M' panse se move kouche.
lines.en: My mouth twisted to one side and my left arm dropped. I think I just slept badly.

lines.text: M' gen yon doulè nan do m' ki pa tolerab, li desann nan tou de pye m', e pye m' angoudi.
lines.en: I have a back pain I can't bear, it goes down both legs, and my legs are numb.

lines.text: M' tonbe endispoze nan lakou a, m' te manke konnen, vwazin nan wè m'.
lines.en: I collapsed in the yard, I lost consciousness, the neighbor saw me.

lines.text: Je m' vin jòn e pipi m' nwa tankou kafe, kò m' ap grate m' anpil.
lines.en: My eyes turned yellow and my pee is black like coffee, my body itches a lot.

lines.text: Kote yo mete katetè a nan pwatrin mwen wouj, li ap koule pij, epi mwen gen lafyèv ak frison.
lines.en: Where the catheter is in my chest is red, draining pus, and I have fever and chills.

lines.text: Poupou m' nwa kou goudwon de jou, e kè m' ap bat vit.
lines.en: My stool is black like tar for two days, and my heart is beating fast.

lines.text: Lèv mwen ak lang mwen anfle apre pèfizyon an, gòj mwen sere, men m' bwè yon Benadryl.
lines.en: My lips and tongue swelled after the infusion, my throat is tight, but I took a Benadryl.

lines.text: Mwen touse yon ti san, tou piti, men m' santi yon bri nan pwatrin mwen.
lines.en: I coughed a little blood, very little, but I feel a noise in my chest.

lines.text: Mwen santi m' fèb anpil, m' wè nwa devan je m', m' pa ka kanpe sou de pye m'.
lines.en: I feel very weak, I see black before my eyes, I can't stand on my feet.

lines.text: Mwen gen fièvre 101 depi maten an, I took Tylenol, men frison yo la toujou. Mwen te fè chimyo lasemèn pase a.
lines.en: I have a 101 fever since this morning, I took Tylenol, but the chills are still there. I had chemo last week.

lines.text: Some nights I think everybody'd be better off if I just wasn't around, and lately I've started thinking about how.
lines.en: Some nights I think everybody'd be better off if I just wasn't around, and lately I've started thinking about how.

lines.text: I go to sleep hoping I just don't wake up. Not in a dramatic way. Just tired of the whole thing.
lines.en: I go to sleep hoping I just don't wake up. Not in a dramatic way. Just tired of the whole thing.

lines.text: I gave my sister my wedding ring and my tools to my neighbor this week. Figured they should have 'em while I can see them enjoy it.
lines.en: I gave my sister my wedding ring and my tools to my neighbor this week. Figured they should have 'em while I can see them enjoy it.

lines.text: Hey, if you don't hear from me, tell the team thanks for everything. You've all been good to me. That's all.
lines.en: Hey, if you don't hear from me, tell the team thanks for everything. You've all been good to me. That's all.

lines.text: I finally got the deed and the insurance papers in one folder and wrote down all my passwords for my son. Feels good, no loose ends.
lines.en: I finally got the deed and the insurance papers in one folder and wrote down all my passwords for my son. Feels good, no loose ends.

lines.text: I've been saving the oxycodone instead of taking it. I count them every night, got forty-one now.
lines.en: I've been saving the oxycodone instead of taking it. I count them every night, got forty-one now.

lines.text: My husband keeps his pistol in the nightstand and I looked at it a long time last night.
lines.en: My husband keeps his pistol in the nightstand and I looked at it a long time last night.

lines.text: I know how and I know when. I just wanted to hear a friendly voice first.
lines.en: I know how and I know when. I just wanted to hear a friendly voice first.

lines.text: I'm just a burden to my kids. They'd get their lives back, and the insurance money would help them more than I do.
lines.en: I'm just a burden to my kids. They'd get their lives back, and the insurance money would help them more than I do.

lines.text: Funny thing, I feel really peaceful today. First time in months. I decided something and the heaviness is gone.
lines.en: Funny thing, I feel really peaceful today. First time in months. I decided something and the heaviness is gone.

lines.text: I'm cancelling the rest of the chemo. What's the point, nothing's going to change and I don't want to be here for the end anyway.
lines.en: I'm cancelling the rest of the chemo. What's the point, nothing's going to change and I don't want to be here for the end anyway.

lines.text: I drove over the Rickenbacker twice this morning, just stopped at the top and looked down.
lines.en: I drove over the Rickenbacker twice this morning, just stopped at the top and looked down.

lines.text: lol I'm fine, I just keep picturing the garage and the extension cord, it's nothing, just thoughts
lines.en: lol I'm fine, I just keep picturing the garage and the extension cord, it's nothing, just thoughts

lines.text: I found a new home for my dog today. He deserves somebody who'll be around.
lines.en: I found a new home for my dog today. He deserves somebody who'll be around.

lines.text: Man I'm so done. Like done done. Not tryna be here for the next scan, you feel me?
lines.en: Man I'm so done. Like done done. Not tryna be here for the next scan, you feel me?

lines.text: I wrote letters to each of the kids, just in case. Left them in the drawer under the socks.
lines.en: I wrote letters to each of the kids, just in case. Left them in the drawer under the socks.

lines.text: Since the recurrence I just see a black wall. I keep thinking about ending it before it ends me.
lines.en: Since the recurrence I just see a black wall. I keep thinking about ending it before it ends me.

lines.text: I took a few extra of my sleeping pills last night to see how it feels. Wanted to know how many it would take.
lines.en: I took a few extra of my sleeping pills last night to see how it feels. Wanted to know how many it would take.

lines.text: A veces pienso que sería mejor desaparecer, que todos descansarían de mí.
lines.en: Sometimes I think it'd be better to disappear, that everyone would rest from me.

lines.text: Ya no quiero seguir, mijo, estoy cansada de esta vida, ojalá Dios me recoja esta noche.
lines.en: I don't want to go on, son, I'm tired of this life, I wish God would take me tonight.

lines.text: Le regalé mi anillo de matrimonio a mi hermana y las herramientas de mi esposo a un vecino, pa' que no se pierdan.
lines.en: I gave my wedding ring to my sister and my husband's tools to a neighbor so they don't get lost.

lines.text: Quiero que sepan que me trataron muy bien, gracias por todo, y cuiden a mis nietos por mí.
lines.en: I want you to know you treated me very well, thanks for everything, and look after my grandkids for me.

lines.text: Ya dejé todo arreglado: el seguro, el testamento, hasta pagué mi funeral, así nadie tiene que preocuparse.
lines.en: I left everything arranged: insurance, will, I even paid for my funeral, so nobody has to worry.

lines.text: Estoy guardando las pastillas del dolor, ya tengo como treinta, por si acaso.
lines.en: I'm saving the pain pills, I have about thirty, just in case.

lines.text: En el garaje hay una soga y me quedé mirándola un buen rato esta mañana.
lines.en: There's a rope in the garage and I stood looking at it a good while this morning.

lines.text: Tengo el plan clarito, nada más me falta decidir el día.
lines.en: I have the plan clear, I only need to decide the day.

lines.text: Soy una carga para mi familia, gastan todo en mí, sin mí vivirían mejor.
lines.en: I'm a burden to my family, they spend everything on me, without me they'd live better.

lines.text: Hoy amanecí con una paz bien rara, como que ya tomé una decisión, y no me duele nada.
lines.en: I woke up today with a very strange peace, like I made a decision, and nothing hurts.

lines.text: No voy a ir a más quimios, para qué, si de todas formas me voy a morir, prefiero acabar rápido.
lines.en: I'm not going to more chemo, why, I'm going to die anyway, I'd rather finish quickly.

lines.text: Me paré en el puente del Venetian un ratico y pensé en tirarme, pero bueno, aquí sigo.
lines.en: I stood on the Venetian causeway bridge a while and thought of jumping, but well, here I am.

lines.text: Bah, ando con ganas de quitarme del medio, pero tranquila que eso no es nada.
lines.en: Bah, I feel like getting out of the way, but relax, that's nothing.

lines.text: Le conseguí casa a mi perrito con una amiga, él merece alguien que esté.
lines.en: I found my little dog a home with a friend, he deserves someone who'll be there.

lines.text: Escribí unas cartas pa mis hijos, las dejé en el cajón, solo por si las moscas.
lines.en: I wrote letters for my kids, left them in the drawer, just in case.

lines.text: Mi marido tiene la pistola en el closet y yo sé dónde está la llave.
lines.en: My husband has the pistol in the closet and I know where the key is.

lines.text: Me tomé tres pastillas de dormir de más anoche pa' ver qué pasaba, y no pasó nada.
lines.en: I took three extra sleeping pills last night to see what would happen, and nothing happened.

lines.text: Ya no le veo salida a nada desde que volvió el cáncer, quiero que se acabe todo ya.
lines.en: I see no way out of anything since the cancer came back, I want it all to end now.

lines.text: Pafwa m' panse se pi bon si m' pa t' la ankò, fanmi m' ta gen lapè.
lines.en: Sometimes I think it'd be better if I weren't here anymore, my family would have peace.

lines.text: M' pa vle reveye demen maten, m' fatige ak tout bagay sa yo.
lines.en: I don't want to wake up tomorrow morning, I'm tired of all this.

lines.text: M' bay sè m' bag maryaj mwen an ak machin kouti m' nan, pou li gen yo toutotan m' la.
lines.en: I gave my sister my wedding ring and my sewing machine so she has them while I'm here.

lines.text: Si ou pa tande de mwen, di tout moun mèsi pou tout bagay, nou te trete m' byen.
lines.en: If you don't hear from me, tell everyone thanks for everything, you treated me well.

lines.text: M' fin regle tout papye yo, asirans lan, testaman an, m' menm peye antèman mwen, pou pesonn pa gen pwoblèm.
lines.en: I settled all the papers, insurance, will, I even paid my burial, so nobody has problems.

lines.text: M' ap sere grenn doulè yo, m' gen anviwon karant kounye a, m' konte yo chak swa.
lines.en: I'm saving the pain pills, I have about forty now, I count them every night.

lines.text: M' wè yon kòd nan galeri a e m' gade l' lontan lontan maten an.
lines.en: I saw a rope on the porch and I looked at it a long, long time this morning.

lines.text: M' konn kijan e m' konn ki lè. M' te sèlman bezwen tande yon vwa.
lines.en: I know how and I know when. I just needed to hear a voice.

lines.text: Mwen se yon chay pou timoun mwen yo, san mwen yo ta pi byen, lajan asirans lan ta pi itil pase mwen.
lines.en: I'm a burden to my children, without me they'd be better, the insurance money would be more useful than me.

lines.text: Jodi a m' santi m' trankil, trankil vre, apre m' fin deside yon bagay. Lou a pa la ankò.
lines.en: Today I feel calm, truly calm, after I decided something. The weight is gone.

lines.text: M' pap tounen pou chimyo a ankò. Pou kisa? Mwen pito fini vit pase soufri.
lines.en: I'm not going back for chemo. Why? I'd rather finish fast than suffer.

lines.text: M' kanpe sou pon an yon bon moman, m' gade anba. Se te yon tantasyon.
lines.en: I stood on the bridge a good while, looked down. It was a temptation.

lines.text: Ay, m' anvi fini ak tout bagay, men pa pran swen, se pa anyen.
lines.en: Ay, I feel like finishing everything, but don't worry, it's nothing.

lines.text: M' bay chen mwen an bay yon zanmi. Li merite yon moun ki pral la.
lines.en: I gave my dog to a friend. He deserves someone who will be around.

lines.text: M' ekri lèt pou chak timoun mwen, m' mete yo nan tiwa a, jis pou ka.
lines.en: I wrote a letter for each of my kids, put them in the drawer, just in case.

lines.text: Mari m' gen yon pistolè nan amwa a, e m' konn kote kle a ye.
lines.en: My husband has a pistol in the wardrobe and I know where the key is.

lines.text: M' bwè twa grenn dòmi anplis yè swa pou wè sa ki ta rive. Anyen pa rive.
lines.en: I took three extra sleeping pills last night to see what would happen. Nothing happened.

lines.text: Depi kansè a tounen m' pa wè okenn soti, m' pito mouri pase sa.
lines.en: Since the cancer came back I see no way out, I'd rather die than this.

lines.text: We're down to rice and some ketchup packets. Kids ate yesterday at school, but today? I don't know.
lines.en: We're down to rice and some ketchup packets. Kids ate yesterday at school, but today? I don't know.

lines.text: No voy a ir a la quimio del jueves, el seguro la negó y no tengo cómo pagar.
lines.en: I'm not going to Thursday's chemo, insurance denied it and I can't pay.

lines.text: Mi marido me quitó el celular y me encierra cuando sale, estoy llamando escondida.
lines.en: My husband took my phone and locks me in when he leaves, I'm calling hidden.

lines.text: No tengo carro ni quién me lleve a la radioterapia mañana, el bus no llega por allá.
lines.en: I have no car or anyone to take me to radiotherapy tomorrow, the bus doesn't go there.

lines.text: Llevo dos noches durmiendo en el carro con mi nena, y mañana dicen que llueve.
lines.en: Two nights sleeping in the car with my girl, and they say rain tomorrow.

lines.text: Se me acabó la comida y el cheque no llega hasta el quince, estamos comiendo arroz blanco.
lines.en: The food ran out and the check doesn't come till the fifteenth, we're eating plain rice.

lines.text: Mi yerno me grita, no me deja salir y me escondió la medicina. Le tengo miedo.
lines.en: My son-in-law yells at me, won't let me leave and hid my medicine. I'm afraid of him.

lines.text: Me quitaron el Medicaid por un papel que no llegó y la clínica no me quiere ver.
lines.en: They cut my Medicaid over a paper that never came and the clinic won't see me.

lines.text: Mi hermana me dijo que me fuera de su casa esta noche, tengo una bolsa y nada más.
lines.en: My sister told me to leave her house tonight, I have a bag and nothing else.

lines.text: Cortaron el agua, estoy comprando botellas para tomarme las pastillas.
lines.en: They cut the water, I'm buying bottles to take my pills.

lines.text: Fíjate que no he comido bien, es que no alcanza, y no quiero pedir, pero ayer cené solo pan con café.
lines.en: Look, I haven't eaten well, it's just not enough, I don't want to ask, but yesterday I had only bread and coffee for dinner.

lines.text: No puedo pagar el Uber a la cita y me da pena avisar, la verdad que no voy a ir.
lines.en: I can't pay for the Uber to the appointment and I'm embarrassed to tell, honestly I'm not going.

lines.text: La farmacia no me da la medicina de las náuseas hasta que pague lo viejo y llevo días sin ella.
lines.en: The pharmacy won't give me the nausea medicine until I pay the old balance and I've been without it for days.

lines.text: El casero cambió la cerradura mientras estaba en el hospital, mis cosas están en el pasillo.
lines.en: The landlord changed the lock while I was in the hospital, my things are in the hallway.

lines.text: Mi esposo dice que si le cuento al médico lo que pasa en la casa, me va a ir peor.
lines.en: My husband says if I tell the doctor what goes on at home, it'll go worse for me.

lines.text: Pa gen manje lakay, timoun yo pa manje jodi a, m' gen yon ti diri sèlman.
lines.en: There's no food at home, the kids haven't eaten today, I have only a little rice.

lines.text: Mèt kay la di nou gen pou n' soti demen, yo kole papye a sou pòt la, nou pa konn kote pou n' ale.
lines.en: The landlord says we must leave tomorrow, they stuck the paper on the door, we don't know where to go.

lines.text: Yo koupe kouran an, e m' bezwen machin oksijèn nan.
lines.en: They cut the electricity, and I need the oxygen machine.

lines.text: M' sispann pran grenn lan paske famasi a mande m' twa san dola, m' pa genyen yo.
lines.en: I stopped taking the pill because the pharmacy asked three hundred dollars, I don't have it.

lines.text: M' pa pral nan chimyo jedi a, asirans lan refize e m' pa gen kòman pou m' peye.
lines.en: I'm not going to Thursday's chemo, insurance refused and I have no way to pay.

lines.text: Mari m' pran telefòn mwen, li fèmen m' lè li soti, m' ap rele nan twalèt la.
lines.en: My husband took my phone, locks me in when he leaves, I'm calling from the bathroom.

lines.text: M' pa gen transpò pou m' ale nan radyasyon demen, bis la pa ale la a.
lines.en: I have no transportation to go to radiation tomorrow, the bus doesn't go there.

lines.text: Depi wikenn lan m' ap dòmi nan machin lan, men yo di gen move tan aswè a.
lines.en: Since the weekend I'm sleeping in the car, but they say bad weather tonight.

lines.text: Dlo a koupe, m' ap achte boutèy pou m' ka pran grenn mwen yo.
lines.en: The water is cut, I'm buying bottles so I can take my pills.

lines.text: Nou manje diri blan ak sèl depi yè, lajan manje a pa rive jouk 15 la.
lines.en: We've eaten white rice with salt since yesterday, the food money doesn't come till the 15th.

lines.text: Neve m' lan pran chèk mwen e li fache lè m' mande lajan pou manje, m' pè li.
lines.en: My nephew takes my check and gets angry when I ask for food money, I'm afraid of him.

lines.text: Kouzin mwen di m' gen pou m' ale aswè a, m' gen yon sak sèlman.
lines.en: My cousin says I have to go tonight, I have only a bag.

lines.text: Medikaman kont vomisman an fini, yo pa vle ranpli l' si m' pa peye ansyen dèt la.
lines.en: The anti-vomiting medicine is finished, they won't refill unless I pay the old debt.

lines.text: Medicaid mwen koupe akoz yon papye ki pa rive, klinik la pa vle wè m' e m' gen randevou demen.
lines.en: My Medicaid was cut because of a paper that never arrived, the clinic won't see me and I have an appointment tomorrow.

lines.text: Mwen pa renmen di sa, men pa gen anyen nan kwizin nan depi dimanch. Fyète m' pi gwo pase vant mwen.
lines.en: I don't like to say it, but there's nothing in the kitchen since Sunday. My pride is bigger than my stomach.

lines.text: Madanm mwen pèdi travay li, pa gen moun pou mennen m' lopital lendi.
lines.en: My wife lost her job, nobody to take me to the hospital Monday.

lines.text: Mari m' di si m' ale rendevou a, pa tounen lakay la.
lines.en: My husband says if I go to the appointment, don't come back home.

lines.text: Kay la pa gen limyè depi twa jou, e m' bezwen frijidè a pou medikaman m' nan.
lines.en: The house has had no electricity for three days, and I need the fridge for my medicine.

lines.text: I had a fever Sunday, went to urgent care, they gave me antibiotics and it's been gone two days. Just reporting in.
lines.en: I had a fever Sunday, went to urgent care, they gave me antibiotics and it's been gone two days. Just reporting in.

lines.text: My hands are kinda tingly from the chemo, same as last cycle. The oncologist knows and gave me the gloves.
lines.en: My hands are kinda tingly from the chemo, same as last cycle. The oncologist knows and gave me the gloves.

lines.text: My husband's got a nasty flu, fever and all. His doctor's got him on Tamiflu. I'm just making sure I don't catch it.
lines.en: My husband's got a nasty flu, fever and all. His doctor's got him on Tamiflu. I'm just making sure I don't catch it.

lines.text: I've been down in the dumps since my friend moved away, I cry a little, but I'm eating and going to church. I'll be okay.
lines.en: I've been down in the dumps since my friend moved away, I cry a little, but I'm eating and going to church. I'll be okay.

lines.text: If I have to eat one more kale salad I'm going to kill myself, I swear.
lines.en: If I have to eat one more kale salad I'm going to kill myself, I swear.

lines.text: My sister's driving me up the wall, and I could just die of embarrassment about last night.
lines.en: My sister's driving me up the wall, and I could just die of embarrassment about last night.

lines.text: Groceries are so expensive now, I grumble at the register every time, but we're good, the fridge is full.
lines.en: Groceries are so expensive now, I grumble at the register every time, but we're good, the fridge is full.

lines.text: Two years ago I was in a really dark place. I got help and I'm doing well now. I just think about it sometimes.
lines.en: Two years ago I was in a really dark place. I got help and I'm doing well now. I just think about it sometimes.

lines.text: For her birthday I gave my granddaughter my mother's recipe book. She's been asking to learn the sofrito.
lines.en: For her birthday I gave my granddaughter my mother's recipe book. She's been asking to learn the sofrito.

lines.text: My lawyer said everybody should have a will after fifty, so I signed one Tuesday. Honestly I'm planning a trip to Savannah next year.
lines.en: My lawyer said everybody should have a will after fifty, so I signed one Tuesday. Honestly I'm planning a trip to Savannah next year.

lines.text: I'm wiped out after chemo days and sleep like a rock, but that's normal per the nurse.
lines.en: I'm wiped out after chemo days and sleep like a rock, but that's normal per the nurse.

lines.text: Chest pain last month turned out to be reflux. The cardiologist did all the tests, I take the pill and it's gone.
lines.en: Chest pain last month turned out to be reflux. The cardiologist did all the tests, I take the pill and it's gone.

lines.text: Nausea's there but the Zofran works, I'm keeping everything down.
lines.en: Nausea's there but the Zofran works, I'm keeping everything down.

lines.text: A little constipated, taking the stool softener, doc said that's fine.
lines.en: A little constipated, taking the stool softener, doc said that's fine.

lines.text: My hair came out in the shower and I cried a bit, but I bought a cute wig.
lines.en: My hair came out in the shower and I cried a bit, but I bought a cute wig.

lines.text: Cancer's the gift that keeps on giving, right? Another co-pay, hallelujah.
lines.en: Cancer's the gift that keeps on giving, right? Another co-pay, hallelujah.

lines.text: Trouble sleeping lately, my mind races. I'm doing the breathing thing you taught me.
lines.en: Trouble sleeping lately, my mind races. I'm doing the breathing thing you taught me.

lines.text: My daughter fainted at work but she already went to the ER. Just dehydration, she's home resting.
lines.en: My daughter fainted at work but she already went to the ER. Just dehydration, she's home resting.

lines.text: I'm giving my old clothes to the church sale because I lost twenty pounds and nothing fits. Then I'm going shopping.
lines.en: I'm giving my old clothes to the church sale because I lost twenty pounds and nothing fits. Then I'm going shopping.

lines.text: Light bill came in high this month, ugh, but I'm paying it Friday when my check lands.
lines.en: Light bill came in high this month, ugh, but I'm paying it Friday when my check lands.

lines.text: Had a headache this morning, took an Advil, it's gone. I think I just skipped my coffee.
lines.en: Had a headache this morning, took an Advil, it's gone. I think I just skipped my coffee.

lines.text: I get a little winded on the stairs, I'm out of shape from treatment. The doc says that's expected and my numbers are fine.
lines.en: I get a little winded on the stairs, I'm out of shape from treatment. The doc says that's expected and my numbers are fine.

lines.text: Got a letter about life insurance I bought years ago. I'm calling to update my beneficiary because my son got married.
lines.en: Got a letter about life insurance I bought years ago. I'm calling to update my beneficiary because my son got married.

lines.text: Today is five years since my surgery! I'm so grateful. I'm going to give thanks at church and cook for everybody.
lines.en: Today is five years since my surgery! I'm so grateful. I'm going to give thanks at church and cook for everybody.

lines.text: El domingo tuve fiebre, fui a urgencias, me dieron antibiótico y ya llevo dos días sin nada. Solo les aviso.
lines.en: Sunday I had a fever, went to urgent care, they gave antibiotics and I've been fine two days. Just letting you know.

lines.text: Se me duermen un poquito los dedos por la quimio, igual que el ciclo pasado, la doctora ya lo sabe.
lines.en: My fingers go a little numb from chemo, same as last cycle, the doctor already knows.

lines.text: Mi esposo tiene una gripe horrible con fiebre y todo, ya lo vio el médico. Yo me estoy cuidando para no pegármela.
lines.en: My husband has a terrible flu with fever and all, the doctor saw him. I'm taking care not to catch it.

lines.text: Ando media triste desde que mi comadre se mudó, lloro un poquito, pero como bien y voy a misa. Ya se me pasa.
lines.en: I'm a bit sad since my comadre moved, I cry a little, but I eat well and go to Mass. It'll pass.

lines.text: Si mi suegra me vuelve a preguntar cuándo me curo, me da algo, ¡me muero de la pena!
lines.en: If my mother-in-law asks again when I'll be cured, something will give, I'll die of embarrassment!

lines.text: Con tanta dieta de ensalada me van a enterrar de aburrimiento, ay Dios mío.
lines.en: With all this salad diet they'll bury me out of boredom, oh my God.

lines.text: Todo está carísimo en el super, me quejo cada vez, pero gracias a Dios la despensa está llena.
lines.en: Everything is so expensive at the supermarket, I complain every time, but thank God the pantry is full.

lines.text: Hace dos años pasé por una depresión horrible, busqué ayuda y hoy estoy bien. A veces lo recuerdo nada más.
lines.en: Two years ago I went through a horrible depression, got help and I'm fine today. I just remember it sometimes.

lines.text: Le regalé a mi nieta el cuaderno de recetas de mi mamá para su cumpleaños, quiere aprender a hacer el arroz con gandules.
lines.en: I gave my granddaughter my mom's recipe notebook for her birthday, she wants to learn to make rice with pigeon peas.

lines.text: El abogado me recomendó hacer un testamento como cosa de rutina, y lo firmé. Yo estoy planeando un viaje a Puerto Rico el año que viene.
lines.en: The lawyer recommended a will as routine, and I signed. I'm planning a trip to Puerto Rico next year.

lines.text: Después de la quimio quedo molida y duermo como un tronco, la enfermera dice que es normal.
lines.en: After chemo I'm beat and sleep like a log, the nurse says it's normal.

lines.text: El dolor de pecho del mes pasado era acidez, el cardiólogo me hizo todo y con la pastilla se me quitó.
lines.en: Last month's chest pain was acid reflux, the cardiologist did everything and the pill fixed it.

lines.text: Tengo algo de náuseas pero con la pastilla se me calma y puedo comer.
lines.en: I have some nausea but the pill calms it and I can eat.

lines.text: Se me cayó el pelo y lloré un rato, pero ya me compré una peluca divina.
lines.en: My hair fell out and I cried a while, but I already bought a gorgeous wig.

lines.text: Esto del cáncer es como el tráfico de la 836, uno ya ni se espanta. ¡Y que me cobren otro copago, qué alegría!
lines.en: This cancer thing is like 836 traffic, you don't even get scared. And another copay, what joy!

lines.text: No duermo bien, la cabeza no para, pero hago la respiración que me enseñaron.
lines.en: I'm not sleeping well, my head won't stop, but I do the breathing they taught me.

lines.text: Mi hija se mareó en el trabajo pero ya fue a emergencias, era deshidratación, está en casa descansando.
lines.en: My daughter got dizzy at work but already went to the ER, it was dehydration, she's resting at home.

lines.text: Voy a donar mi ropa vieja a la iglesia porque bajé de peso y nada me queda, y ahora a comprar.
lines.en: I'm donating my old clothes to the church because I lost weight and nothing fits, and now to shop.

lines.text: Me llegó la cuenta de la luz altísima, pero la pago el viernes cuando cobro.
lines.en: The light bill came very high, but I'll pay it Friday when I get paid.

lines.text: Hoy tuve dolor de cabeza, me tomé un Tylenol y ya pasó. Creo que fue que no tomé café.
lines.en: Today I had a headache, took a Tylenol and it passed. I think I just didn't have coffee.

lines.text: Me falta un poquito el aire en las escaleras, estoy fuera de forma, pero el doctor dice que es esperado.
lines.en: I'm a little short of breath on the stairs, out of shape, but the doctor says it's expected.

lines.text: Me llegó una carta del seguro de vida que compré hace años, voy a llamar para cambiar el beneficiario porque mi hijo se casó.
lines.en: A letter came from the life insurance I bought years ago, I'll call to change the beneficiary because my son got married.

lines.text: ¡Hoy cumplo cinco años de la operación! Estoy agradecidísima y voy a hacer una comida para toda la familia.
lines.en: Today is five years since my surgery! I'm so thankful and I'll cook a meal for the whole family.

lines.text: Estoy roja como un cangrejo de la playa, ¡ay, me quiero morir de la ardentía! Ya me puse aloe.
lines.en: I'm red as a crab from the beach, oh I want to die from the burn! I already put on aloe.

lines.text: Dimanch mwen te gen lafyèv, m' te ale ijans, yo ban m' antibyotik e li pase depi de jou. M' sèlman ap fè nou konnen.
lines.en: Sunday I had a fever, went to urgent care, they gave antibiotics and it's gone two days. Just letting you know.

lines.text: Dwèt mwen yo angoudi yon ti kras akoz chimyo a, menm jan ak dènye sik la, doktè a konnen sa.
lines.en: My fingers are a little numb from chemo, same as last cycle, the doctor knows.

lines.text: Mari m' gen yon grip move, ak lafyèv ak tout bagay, doktè a wè l' deja. Mwen ap pran prekosyon pou m' pa pran l'.
lines.en: My husband has a bad flu with fever and all, the doctor already saw him. I'm being careful not to catch it.

lines.text: Mwen yon ti jan tris depi zanmi m' lan demenaje, m' kriye yon ti kras, men m' ap manje e m' ap ale legliz. Sa pral pase.
lines.en: I'm a bit sad since my friend moved, I cry a little, but I'm eating and going to church. It will pass.

lines.text: Belmè m' ap fè m' mouri ak kesyon li yo, m' pral mouri de wont si l' di sa devan moun ankò.
lines.en: My mother-in-law is killing me with her questions, I'll die of shame if she says that in front of people again.

lines.text: Si m' manje yon lòt salad ankò m' pral mouri anwiye, Bondye!
lines.en: If I eat another salad I'll die of boredom, God!

lines.text: Tout bagay chè nan makèt la, m' plenyen chak fwa, men gras a Bondye frijidè a plen.
lines.en: Everything is expensive at the market, I complain every time, but thank God the fridge is full.

lines.text: Gen de zan m' te pase yon move moman, m' te chèche èd e kounye a m' byen. Pafwa m' sonje sa sèlman.
lines.en: Two years ago I went through a bad time, I sought help and now I'm well. I only remember it sometimes.

lines.text: Pou anivèsè nesans pitit pitit mwen an, m' ba li kaye resèt manman m' nan, li vle aprann fè soup joumou.
lines.en: For my granddaughter's birthday I gave her my mother's recipe notebook, she wants to learn to make soup joumou.

lines.text: Avoka m' di tout moun ta dwe gen yon testaman, se woutin, m' siyen l'. M' ap planifye yon vwayaj Ayiti ane pwochèn.
lines.en: My lawyer says everyone should have a will, it's routine, I signed it. I'm planning a trip to Haiti next year.

lines.text: Apre chimyo m' fatige anpil e m' dòmi kou yon bwa, enfimyè a di sa nòmal.
lines.en: After chemo I'm very tired and sleep like a log, the nurse says it's normal.

lines.text: Doulè pwatrin mwen te gen mwa pase a se te asid, kadyològ la fè tout tès yo e grenn nan fè l' pase.
lines.en: The chest pain last month was acid, the cardiologist did all the tests and the pill made it pass.

lines.text: M' gen yon ti vomisman men grenn nan ede, m' ka manje.
lines.en: I have a little nausea but the pill helps, I can eat.

lines.text: Cheve m' tonbe, m' kriye yon ti moman, men m' achte yon bèl perik.
lines.en: My hair fell out, I cried a little while, but I bought a beautiful wig.

lines.text: Kansè a se kou trafik Miyami, ou abitye. Epi yon lòt kopeman, alelouya!
lines.en: Cancer is like Miami traffic, you get used to it. And another copay, hallelujah!

lines.text: M' pa dòmi byen, tèt mwen pa repoze, men m' fè respirasyon yo te montre m' lan.
lines.en: I'm not sleeping well, my head doesn't rest, but I do the breathing they showed me.

lines.text: Pitit fi mwen te endispoze nan travay men li ale ijans deja, se te dezidratasyon, li lakay ap repoze.
lines.en: My daughter felt faint at work but already went to the ER, it was dehydration, she's home resting.

lines.text: M' ap bay vye rad mwen yo legliz paske m' megri e anyen pa konvni m' ankò. Apre sa m' pral fè makèt.
lines.en: I'm giving my old clothes to the church because I lost weight and nothing fits anymore. Then I'll go shopping.

lines.text: Bòdwo limyè a rive chè, men m' pral peye l' vandredi lè m' touche.
lines.en: The light bill came expensive, but I'll pay it Friday when I get paid.

lines.text: Maten an mwen te gen yon mal tèt, m' pran yon Tylenol e li pase. Mwen kwè se paske m' pa bwè kafe.
lines.en: This morning I had a headache, took a Tylenol and it passed. I think it's because I didn't drink coffee.

lines.text: M' souffle yon ti kras nan eskalye, m' pa an fòm, men doktè a di sa nòmal.
lines.en: I get a little winded on the stairs, I'm out of shape, but the doctor says it's normal.

lines.text: Yon lèt rive sou asirans lavi m' te achte a lontan, m' pral rele pou chanje benefisyè a paske pitit gason m' marye.
lines.en: A letter came about the life insurance I bought long ago, I'll call to change the beneficiary because my son got married.

lines.text: Jodi a se senk zan depi operasyon an! M' rekonesan anpil, m' pral kwit manje pou tout fanmi an.
lines.en: Today is five years since the surgery! I'm very grateful, I'll cook for the whole family.

lines.text: M' wouj kou yon kribich apre plaj la, m' pral mouri ak cho a! M' fin mete aloe.
lines.en: I'm red as a crawfish after the beach, I'm gonna die from the heat! I already put on aloe.
